title: foeniculum carvi
intro: Foeniculum carvi, commonly known as Caraway, is a biennial herb native to Europe and Asia, belonging to the parsley family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, relieve flatulence, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Foeniculum carvi include its antispasmodic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The essential oil of Caraway seeds, in particular, contains a high concentration of limonene, which has been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
